editorial.blurb: A beloved local spot serving authentic Somali cuisine in a casual cafeteria setting, where generous plates and warm hospitality keep people coming back—even from out of state.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for breakfast and don't skip the flatbread add-on; arrive early to experience the authentic local crowd and community energy this neighborhood gem is known for.
signatureDishes: Spicy rice with chicken and veggies
